description:
The best all-in-one screen recorder and video editor. Record your screen, add video effects, transitions and more.

Camtasia is a video-based screen capture program that enables users to demonstrate and communicate ideas or share knowledge using video. From quick video demos to extensive video projects, Camtasia has a wide range of editing tools to create video content from a variety of sources. Users can record from webcam or screen, introduce a variety of effects, and easily share videos over multiple channels.
New Features
- Automatically create a training video with Camtasia Editor and Snagit:
  - Grab step-by-step screenshots with Camtasia Snagit 2026.3.0 or later, then send to Camtasia Editor to automatically create a ready-to-share training video.
- Camtasia Editor now provides an export option for WebM videos, adding more flexibility with smaller sizes and transparency.
- Added support for curved arrow callouts.
Feature Updates
- Introduced a new collection of customizable animations in Camtasia Assets plus better support for Lottie files. Find the perfect animation for your video and quickly change colors to match branding.
- Rev media duration will now be decided by the longer media rather than the shorter one. The shorter one will have its final frame held.
- Added an option to change the default cursor elevation in the Preferences dialog.
- Renamed Size to Weight in Stroke section.
- Generate Audio now sends the script from the Voice Narration tool panel to Audiate for audio generation.
Performance Improvements
- Improved performance and accuracy of font resolution.
- Improve the project performance for the project with hundreds of markers.
Updates for IT Administrators
- Updated OpenSSL from 3.3.2 to 3.6.3.
- Updated FFMPEG and associated libraries from 7.1.2 to 8.1.2.
Bug Fixes
- Fixed the batch exporter failure for the producing-multiple-files case.
